content_zh:
第9章我爹不认字
“大哥！”
“老大！”
十几个小弟围了上去，扶起倒地的大哥，
谢三刀在这一拳下，
半边身子都在隐隐作痛，
眼中有惊骇，有忌惮，
他不是还没有凝气成功！
身为凝气五重的武者，按理说应该碾压铸体期武者，
即便是大族天才，也必定不是他的对手，
可面对江尘，他竟被一拳击退！
他阴着脸道：
“你隐藏了实力！
你到凝气期了！”
江尘嘴角略有嘲弄，笑呵呵的说道：
“当然还没到凝气期，若是凝气，刚刚一拳，你已经死了。”
谢三刀怒气冲天，脸色扭曲，
区区一个铸体期武者，
也敢在凝气期面前放肆！
他体内血气澎湃，真元随着怒火轰然爆发，

双掌如同染上红芒，
“武技！
这是武技！”
一些人已经看出了谢三刀施展的功法，发出一声惊呼，
他们有些人虽已达凝气，
但哪怕最低阶的战技，也价值数千两，
根本不是他们能消费起的，
“难怪在咱们天武城这么嚣张，竟然习得了武技，谁能是他的对手！”
“江尘这下糟了！”
谢三刀一拳击出，竟化出数道红色拳影袭向江尘，
江尘面不改色，
这种空有其形的战技，
攻击力甚至不如一头二阶妖兽，
更遑论现在他气力已达两万斤，他挥拳而去，
啪！
啪！
啪！
红色拳影骤然炸开，
气劲崩碎，如波纹般向四周散去，
江尘倒退数步，面上一顿潮红，
content_en:
Chapter 9 My father can’t read
"Brother!"
"Boss!"
More than a dozen younger brothers gathered around and helped up the elder brother who fell to the ground.
Xie Sandao was struck by this punch.
Half of my body is aching.
There is horror and fear in the eyes,
Didn’t he succeed in condensing Qi yet?
As a warrior at the fifth level of Qi Condensation, it stands to reason that he should crush the warriors at the casting stage.
Even if he is a genius from a wealthy family, he will definitely not be his opponent.
But facing Jiang Chen, he was knocked back by a punch!
He said with a sullen face:
"You hide your strength!
You have reached the stage of condensation! "
Jiang Chen's mouth was slightly mocking, and he said with a smile:
"Of course I haven't reached the Qi condensation stage yet. If it were, I would have just punched you and you would be dead."
Xie Sandao was furious, his face twisted,
A mere warrior in the casting stage,
Dare to act arrogantly in front of Qi Condensation Period!
The blood in his body was surging, and his true energy exploded with anger.
Both palms seem to be stained with red light,
"Martial skills!
This is martial arts! "
Some people had seen the technique performed by Xie Sandao and exclaimed,
Although some of them have reached Qi Condensation,
But even the lowest level combat skills are worth thousands of taels.
It's simply not something they can afford.
"No wonder he is so arrogant in our Tianwu City and has learned martial arts. Who can be his opponent?"
"Jiang Chen is in a bad situation!"
Xie Sandao punched out and turned into several red fist shadows to attack Jiang Chen.
Jiang Chen's expression did not change.
This kind of invisible combat skill,
The attack power is not even as good as a second-level monster beast.
Not to mention that now his strength has reached 20,000 kilograms. He punches away.
Snap!
Snap!
Snap!
The red fist shadow suddenly exploded,
The energy collapsed and spread around like ripples.
Jiang Chen took a few steps back, his face flushed.
